description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Move the application's relational data layer from Oracle to Azure Database for PostgreSQL while preserving photo storage and application behavior.
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle Database with Oracle-specific JDBC driver, OracleDialect, and BLOB data types. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service on Azure, eliminating the need for self-managed Oracle infrastructure.
tasks.requirements: Replace Oracle datasource connectivity with PostgreSQL-compatible configuration and managed identity authentication. Migrate the JDBC driver, Spring datasource configuration, JPA dialect, SQL syntax, and schema definitions to Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Convert photo BLOB storage to PostgreSQL bytea and ensure repository queries and schema definitions are PostgreSQL-compatible.
